notes.title: Game Update: New Easy Mode
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! 

We just updated our game with a new "Easy Mode". We want our game to be played by everyone, and this update makes it more accesible. Enemies have less health but the core gameplay of reactions, resource management and strategy remains untouched.

We hope you can give our game a chance!

tags.feature: - Added a new "Easy Mode" to the game.

notes.title: Game Update: New Mode + New Pricing
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We listened to your feedback and decided for this update to adjust the price of the game, it is now $4.99.

Also, another complaint was the little replayability so we added a new mode, called Endless Mode.

This mode has a more arcade and dynamic feeling than the main mode, and features new art, a new main character and new mechanics. In this mode, the objective is to survive as long as possible and kill as many enemies as possible as well. So, share your records with us!

The game will be discounted a 20% for a few weeks too! 

Pura vida,
Team Gizmoid.

notes.title: Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We patched the game today. Just fixed some bugs and added tips that makes things like "autosaving" and pausing the game clearer.

We are also working on new content for the game ( a new game mode with new art! ) , so stay tuned!
